entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: How are things going in regard to that[n]matter we spoke of earlier?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I have nothing to report yet...

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Nothing at all? How many students[n]are there who could provoke a teacher?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I've already narrowed it down. I just[n]can't get any solid evidence...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You knew, didn't you? About[n]Mr. Kamoshida sexually harassing[n]students.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sir!

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: What will come of you asking that?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This investigation is for a just cause,[n]correct?

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: I believe I understand how flustered[n]this must be making you.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: I'm sure it was truly shocking for you[n]as student council president to see[n]a peer attempt suicide...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes...

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: We must provide a school environment[n]where all students can feel at ease.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: That is the most pressing issue we have[n]to tackle at the moment.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So that's your reason behind this[n]investigation on the Phantom Thieves[n]of Hearts?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We don't even know if they truly exist.[n]Why are you—

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: You heard about the incident with that[n]Madarame fellow, I assume?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...They said there was a similar calling[n]card to the one used in Mr. Kamoshida's[n]case.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: I wish to believe that this is unrelated[n]to our students.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes...

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: That is where I stand. I suggest you[n]devote your energy to the task at hand,[n]not unnecessary questions.
